def transform(grid):

    seen = set()

            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or color == floor_color or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
